character: Legendary 6.2km Australian circuit with 174m elevation change. Part public road, part purpose-built. The Mountain section is narrow and unforgiving with concrete walls. Conrod Straight allows 300+ km/h before heavy braking. Demands bravery on the Mountain and precision everywhere.
sources: https://www.racingcircuits.info/oceania/australia/mount-panorama.html Bathurst corner naming (Hell Corner, Griffins Bend, Skyline, The Dipper, Forrest's Elbow, The Chase, Murray's Corner) long-established

corners.name: Hell Corner
corners.technique: Hard braking, late apex. Exit speed starts the Mountain climb
corners.trap: Over-cooking entry and running wide — narrow exit

corners.name: Mountain Straight
corners.technique: Full throttle up the steep climb, prepare for Griffins Bend
corners.trap: Not anticipating the crest and gradient changes

corners.name: Griffins Bend
corners.technique: Commitment over the blind crest, trust the racing line
corners.trap: Lifting over the crest kills momentum

corners.name: The Cutting
corners.technique: Precision is critical — concrete walls on both sides. Smooth, committed driving
corners.trap: Any correction near the walls risks contact

corners.name: Reid Park
corners.technique: Hard braking, precise through the direction changes. Walls are very close
corners.trap: Over-driving into the first part with walls millimeters away

corners.name: Skyline
corners.type: crest at the top of the Mountain
corners.technique: Car goes light over the top — smooth inputs, let it settle
corners.trap: Aggressive steering when the car is light = instant snap

corners.name: The Esses
corners.technique: Descending quickly with walls close. Rhythm and commitment, carry speed
corners.trap: Over-driving while descending — the gradient increases speed rapidly

corners.name: The Dipper
corners.technique: Car loads up in the dip — use the grip from compression

corners.name: Forrest Elbow
corners.technique: Late apex is critical — feeds the enormously fast Conrod Straight
corners.trap: Early apex = slow Conrod Straight = massive time loss

corners.name: Conrod Straight
corners.technique: Full throttle, 300+ km/h. Prepare braking for The Chase
corners.trap: Not preparing early enough for the braking zone at The Chase

corners.name: The Chase
corners.technique: Enormous braking zone from 300+ km/h. Hard, straight-line braking, precise through chicane
corners.trap: Braking too late from the extremely high speeds; ABS fade

corners.name: Murray's Corner
corners.technique: Late apex, progressive throttle. Exit speed feeds start/finish straight
corners.trap: Over-committing on entry and losing exit drive
